by
  let hf_bounded := hf_infinity
  let ⟨M, A⟩ := UpperHalfPlane.isBoundedAtImInfty_iff hf_bounded
  let h_compact := Continuous.continuousOn_compact (UpperHalfPlane.compact_half_plane A)
  let h_bound_compact := hf_cont.continuousOn_boundedOn h_compact
  let h_bound_compact' := h_bound_compact M
  let C := max M (h_bound_compact'.1)
  exact ⟨C, λ τ, max_le C M (h_bound_compact'.2 τ)⟩
